answer: The delta schedule is applied in ember and prism shows each instalment. A payout is split which means 28% arrives at settlement and the rest over 8 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3747 identities would post 2104 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
